messages:
jon: heads up — noticed a sudden tail latency spike on the us-east-1 hosted pool. p50 ~3x, p95 ~6x starting ~2025-10-12T13:02Z. traces attached.
perf-bot: ALERT: api/redwood-gen latency p95 > 1200ms at 2025-10-12T13:02:10Z (baseline 180ms) <https://alerts.internal/12345|details>
maya: I'm on it — grabbing perf traces and kernel profiles now. can someone check recent infra/driver changes?
sasha: saw the same on dashboard. throughput down ~40% on rack-3 node group.
jon: flamegraph uploaded — long-running kernel at step 4, labelled 'fused_attn_forward_v2' (FlashAttention). lots of small matmuls stacking up too.
maya: repro container started, running nvprof to capture kernels.
maya: ```bash
nvprof --log-file nvprof.log --profile-child-processes true python serve_repro.py --model redwood-7b
grep 'Elapsed time' nvprof.log | head
```
maya: nvprof output shows a clear jump in 'triton_matmul' and 'fused_attn_forward_v2' timings right after 2025-10-12T12:55Z.
jon: ops — any infra changes around then?
ryan: we rolled a host patch at 12:50 that included CUDA driver upgrade 535.86 -> 535.100 (security CVE fix).
sasha: canaries still on 535.86 look fine, impact only on nodes with 535.100. that points to driver/ABI regression.
jon: also saw runtime logs where Triton's kernel selector fell back to cuBLAS for shapes that previously used our optimized kernels: "selected kernel: cublas_gemm_ex (shape=128x1024x1024)" repeated.
maya: FlashAttention v2.1 was rebuilt recently; combined with new driver kernels that could change heuristics or launch overhead.
ops: i can roll back the driver on two canary racks (rack-3a, rack-3b). want me to proceed? :eyes: 
ryan: rollback rack-3a and confirm latency before wider rollback.
ops: starting rollback on rack-3a — command used: ```ansible-playbook -i rack-3a playbooks/driver_rollback.yml -e driver_version=535.86```
deploy-bot: Job 789 started: driver rollback on rack-3a (operator=ops)
ops: rollback finished on rack-3a, restarting inference service and warming caches.
maya: post-rollback metrics from rack-3a: p95 back to ~210ms (near baseline). rack-3b still on 535.100 and still impacted.
jon: rollback impact isolates regression to driver 535.100. we should open a bug with the driver vendor and also prepare a runtime-side mitigation (kernel-selector tweaks).
sasha: i'll draft a quick kernel-selector patch to prefer FlashAttention fused_attn_forward_v1 for these shape patterns when driver_version >= 535.100 causes slowdown. patch will be small runtime hint mapping.
jon: also record: Triton reported a change in workspace allocation behavior under 535.100 which may push MatMul into cuBLAS path due to alignment/stride changes. include that in the vendor report.
ryan: followups: 1) file vendor bug with repro and nvprof logs; 2) add automated perf gate to driver rollouts; 3) add correlation alert between infra patches and latency spikes.
maya: created INCIDENT-2025-1043 with links to nvprof, flamegraphs, and node-level logs <https://incidents.internal/INCIDENT-2025-1043|incident doc>. remediation steps: driver rollback (done), runtime kernel-selector patch (in review), vendor tracking. cc @ryan.
ops: rolling rollback to rack-3b now as precaution.
jon: thanks everyone. Marking this thread for follow-up until vendor and selector patch are done. will close after prod canary confirms stability.
